term: nonempty-family conditional coverage of caused simples
definition: CausedSimples G selects IsMin objects with an incoming G.edge. If that family is nonempty, ConditionalCausedSimpleCover requires some object u containing every selected member, using existing Covers. No formation is required for an empty family; no no-extra-parts, extensionality, composition-as-identity or unrestricted-fusion principle is included.
note: Primary P4p127 is a NONEMPTY conditional for an object-valued sum, unlike the abbreviated slide. Containment is only a weaker consequence of that sum. Object population remains a separate input; the proof derives family nonemptiness inside its all-caused reductio.
